2
Mmusuakuo no nsraban nhyehyɛɛ
1Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose ne Aaron sɛ: 2#Num 1 Israelfoɔ no nkyere nsraban, wɔn mu biara wɔ ɔno ara ne frankaa ho, ɛne wɔn mpanimfie nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ho; ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ntentensoɔ na wɔnkyere nsraban no nhyia. 3Wɔn a wɔnkyere nsraban apueeɛ fam no ne Yuda nsraban frankaa no ase nnipa sɛdeɛ wɔn dɔm teɛ. Yuda mma no safohempanin Aminadab ba Nahason, 4na ne dɔm a wɔkan wɔn no, mpem aduɔson nnan ne ahansia. 5Na wɔn a wɔnkyere nsraban ntoa soɔ ne Isakar abusuakuo. Isakar mma no safohempanin Suar ba Netanel, 6na ne dɔm a wɔkan wɔn no, mpem aduonum nnan ne ahanan. 7Sebulon abusuakuo na ɛtoa soɔ. Sebulon mma no safohempanin ne Helon ba Eliab, 8na ne dɔm a wɔkan wɔn no yɛ mpem aduonum nson ne ahanan. 9Wɔn a wɔkan wɔn maa Yuda nsraban no nyinaa yɛ ɔpeha aduɔwɔtwe nsia ne ahanan, sɛdeɛ wɔn dɔm ahodoɔ no teɛ; wɔn na wɔntu kane.
10Ruben nsraban frankaa ase nnipa nni anafoɔ fam, sɛdeɛ wɔn dɔm ahodoɔ no teɛ. Ruben mma no safohempanin ne Sedeur ba Elisur, 11na ne dɔm a wɔkan wɔn no yɛ mpem aduanan nsia ne ahanum. 12Na wɔn a wɔnkyere nsraban ntoa ne soɔ ne Simeon abusuakuo. Simeon mma safohempanin Surisadai ba Selumiel, 13na ne dɔm a wɔkan wɔn no yɛ mpem aduonum nkron ne ahasa. 14Na Gad abusuakuo na ɛntoa soɔ. Gad mma no safohempanin ne Reuel ba Eliasaf, 15na ne dɔm a wɔkan wɔn mpem aduanan nnum ne ahansia aduonum. 16Wɔn a wɔkan wɔn maa Ruben nsraban no nyinaa yɛ ɔpeha aduonum baako ne ahanan aduonum, sɛdeɛ wɔn dɔm ahodoɔ no teɛ, na wɔn na wɔntɔ so mmienu ntu.
17Afei ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ne Lewifoɔ nsraban no ntu nni nsraban ahodoɔ no ntam. Sɛdeɛ wɔkyere nsraban no, saa ara na wɔntuo, wɔn nyinaa wɔ wɔn dibea sɛdeɛ wɔn mfrankaa no teɛ.
18Efraim nsraban frankaa nni atɔeɛ fam, sɛdeɛ wɔn dɔm ahodoɔ no teɛ. Efraim mma safohempanin ne Amihud ba Elisama, 19na ne dɔm a wɔkan wɔn no, mpem aduanan ahanum. 20Na Manase abusuakuo ntoa so. Manase mma no safohempanin ne Pedahsur ba Gamaliel, 21na ne dɔm a wɔkan wɔn no, mpem aduasa mmienu ne ahanu. 22Na Benyamin abusuakuo no na ɛntoa soɔ. Benyamin mma no safohempanin ne Gideoni ba Abidan 23na ne dɔm a wɔkan wɔn no, mpem aduasa nnum ne ahanan. 24Wɔn a wɔkan wɔn maa Efraim nsraban no nyinaa yɛ nnipa mpemha ne nwɔtwe, ne ɔha sɛdeɛ wɔn dɔm ahodoɔ no teɛ; na wɔn na wɔntɔ so mmiɛnsa ntuo.
25Dan nsraban frankaa nni atifi fam, sɛdeɛ wɔn dɔm ahodoɔ no teɛ. Dan mma no safohempanin ne Amisadai ba Ahieser, 26na ne dɔm a wɔkan wɔn no yɛ mpem aduosia mmienu ne ahanson. 27Na wɔn a wɔnkyere nsraban ntoa ne soɔ ne Aser abusuakuo. Aser mma no safohempanin ne Okran ba Pagiel, 28na ne dɔm a wɔkan wɔn no yɛ mpem aduanan baako ne ahanum. 29Na Naftali abusuakuo na ɛntoa soɔ. Naftali mma no safohempanin ne Enan ba Ahira, 30na ne dɔm a wɔkan wɔn no, mpem aduonum mmiɛnsa ne ahanan. 31Wɔn a wɔkan wɔn maa Dan nsraban yɛ ɔpeha aduonum nson ne ahansia; wɔn na wɔnni akyire ntuo sɛdeɛ wɔn mfrankaa no teɛ.
32 # Num 1.46 Yeinom ne Israelfoɔ a wɔkan wɔn, sɛdeɛ wɔn mpanimfie teɛ, nsraban ahodoɔ no mu wɔn a wɔkan wɔn nyinaa, sɛdeɛ wɔn dɔm ahodoɔ no teɛ, yɛ ɔpeha nsia ne mmiɛnsa ne ahanum aduonum. 33#Num 1.48-49 Na Lewifoɔ no deɛ, wɔankan wɔn amfra Israelfoɔ no, sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no.
34 # Num 2.2 Na Israelfoɔ no yɛɛ sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no nyinaa. Wɔkyeree nsraban, sɛdeɛ wɔn mfrankaa no teɛ, na saa nso na wɔtuiɛ, wɔn nyinaa, sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua ne wɔn mpanimfie teɛ no.

Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose ne Aaron sɛ: Israelfoɔ no nkyere nsraban, wɔn mu biara wɔ ɔno ara ne frankaa ho, ɛne wɔn mpanimfie nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ho; ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ntentensoɔ na wɔnkyere nsraban no nhyia. Wɔn a wɔnkyere nsraban apueeɛ fam no ne Yuda nsraban frankaa no ase nnipa sɛdeɛ wɔn dɔm teɛ. Yuda mma no safohempanin Aminadab ba Nahason, na ne dɔm a wɔkan wɔn no, mpem aduɔson nnan ne ahansia. Na wɔn a wɔnkyere nsraban ntoa soɔ ne Isakar abusuakuo. Isakar mma no safohempanin Suar ba Netanel, na ne dɔm a wɔkan wɔn no, mpem aduonum nnan ne ahanan. Sebulon abusuakuo na ɛtoa soɔ. Sebulon mma no safohempanin ne Helon ba Eliab, na ne dɔm a wɔkan wɔn no yɛ mpem aduonum nson ne ahanan. Wɔn a wɔkan wɔn maa Yuda nsraban no nyinaa yɛ ɔpeha aduɔwɔtwe nsia ne ahanan, sɛdeɛ wɔn dɔm ahodoɔ no teɛ; wɔn na wɔntu kane.

Gad mma no safohempanin ne Reuel ba Eliasaf, na ne dɔm a wɔkan wɔn mpem aduanan nnum ne ahansia aduonum. Wɔn a wɔkan wɔn maa Ruben nsraban no nyinaa yɛ ɔpeha aduonum baako ne ahanan aduonum, sɛdeɛ wɔn dɔm ahodoɔ no teɛ, na wɔn na wɔntɔ so mmienu ntu.
Afei ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ne Lewifoɔ nsraban no ntu nni nsraban ahodoɔ no ntam. Sɛdeɛ wɔkyere nsraban no, saa ara na wɔntuo, wɔn nyinaa wɔ wɔn dibea sɛdeɛ wɔn mfrankaa no teɛ.
Efraim nsraban frankaa nni atɔeɛ fam, sɛdeɛ wɔn dɔm ahodoɔ no teɛ. Efraim mma safohempanin ne Amihud ba Elisama, na ne dɔm a wɔkan wɔn no, mpem aduanan ahanum. Na Manase abusuakuo ntoa so. Manase mma no safohempanin ne Pedahsur ba Gamaliel, na ne dɔm a wɔkan wɔn no, mpem aduasa mmienu ne ahanu. Na Benyamin abusuakuo no na ɛntoa soɔ. Benyamin mma no safohempanin ne Gideoni ba Abidan na ne dɔm a wɔkan wɔn no, mpem aduasa nnum ne ahanan. Wɔn a wɔkan wɔn maa Efraim nsraban no nyinaa yɛ nnipa mpemha ne nwɔtwe, ne ɔha sɛdeɛ wɔn dɔm ahodoɔ no teɛ; na wɔn na wɔntɔ so mmiɛnsa ntuo.
Dan nsraban frankaa nni atifi fam, sɛdeɛ wɔn dɔm ahodoɔ no teɛ. Dan mma no safohempanin ne Amisadai ba Ahieser, na ne dɔm a wɔkan wɔn no yɛ mpem aduosia mmienu ne ahanson. Naftali mma no safohempanin ne Enan ba Ahira, na ne dɔm a wɔkan wɔn no, mpem aduonum mmiɛnsa ne ahanan. Yeinom ne Israelfoɔ a wɔkan wɔn, sɛdeɛ wɔn mpanimfie teɛ, nsraban ahodoɔ no mu wɔn a wɔkan wɔn nyinaa, sɛdeɛ wɔn dɔm ahodoɔ no teɛ, yɛ ɔpeha nsia ne mmiɛnsa ne ahanum aduonum. Na Lewifoɔ no deɛ, wɔankan wɔn amfra Israelfoɔ no, sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
